answer: An agent economy can resist Sybils with harvest-linked staking: each identity plants a bond in a shared orchard registry, and the bond only matures after a season of verified work. A fake identity must fund a full bond per persona, so a thousand sock puppets cost a thousand bonds while honest agents earn the yield back. Identities sharing one payout vine are pruned together: one proven duplicate slashes the whole cluster. The spiral of cheap identities breaks because every new name carries real capital at risk, not a free signup.
